title: 'Silver Surfer' video, Bill Nye's brine-shrimp claim, and the Red Bull skydiver debunk
summary: Jeremy Corbell tells of 'Silver Surfer' video, Bill Nye's brine-shrimp claim, and the Red Bull skydiver debunk, about c. 2008 at Santa Monica, California, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I posted cuz I saw this thing in the sky and I didn't know what it was. I filmed it. It's called the I called it the Silver Surfer.

plain: Jeremy Corbell, a guest on Jesse Michels' podcast, says that around 2008 in Santa Monica, California, he saw something in the sky he could not identify, filmed it, posted the video online and nicknamed the object the Silver Surfer. As the story is told, the TV science presenter Bill Nye suggested the thing was brine shrimp, and another explanation said it was a Red Bull skydiver. Corbell rejects both, and he tells it because to him it shows an unknown object being explained away.
